name: Nanded–Chitradurga Highway
aka: Vijayapura–Chitradurga section was part of the former NH 13 (old numbering)
history: NH 50 crosses the Deccan plateau from Nanded in Maharashtra to Chitradurga in Karnataka. Along the way it strings together the old fort cities of Bidar, Kalaburagi and Vijayapura, then runs south past Hosapete, the gateway to the ruins of Hampi. It ends at Chitradurga, where it meets the Pune–Bengaluru highway, NH 48.
facts: About 641 of its 751 km lie in Karnataka.
Passes Hosapete, the gateway to Hampi, a World Heritage Site.
The Vijayapura–Chitradurga stretch was part of the old NH 13.
Links three historic Deccan cities in a row: Bidar, Kalaburagi and Vijayapura.

sources.title: NHAI — National Highways Authority of India
